meta.title: Pre-decision Q&A register - questions, information needed, known answers, and what is missing
meta.author: arena/4a709dd0-korea2
meta.rule: Every answer below was checked against a named source in this session or is explicitly marked as missing. Nothing is inferred. 'blocks' names the decisions that cannot reasonably be made until the missing information exists.

rows.question: Where can opening and closing odds be obtained from an official source?
rows.information_needed: An authoritative, timestamped odds source covering the origination window (2023-2026) for spread, total and moneyline markets.
known_answers: No official body publishes historical betting odds. NFL.com score and game pages carry no odds (checked on 2026-11-14 while verifying results).
The repository's only opening-line archive is origination-lab/data/raw/initial_lines.csv (WSGT, 2021 season, spread/total only) - outside our window.
Closing numbers exist only as a third-party archive (games.csv.gz, nflverse-derived; closing_lines.csv 2006-2018 with outcomes).
rows.missing: A licensed or official odds feed for opens and closes.
discovery_suggestions: Approach a licensed odds provider or book partnership for a research data licence (this is the only route to genuinely official prices).
Check whether the Nevada Gaming Control Board or a state regulator publishes any historical line archive (none is known - would need confirmation).

Begin recording our own point-in-time snapshots from a licensed feed going forward - the store schema in price-desk already reserves the columns (PS-1 becomes self-sustaining from the day a feed exists).
blocks: Verified price columns in the snapshot store

rows.question: Which results are officially verified, and how do we verify the rest?
rows.information_needed: Digit-for-digit final scores from an official source for every settled game used in a backtest.
known_answers: 22 games are verified-official as of 2026-11-14 (2026 weeks 8-10) from nfl.com scores pages and two official gamebooks; 5 of these were cross-checked against the third-party archive and all 5 agreed.
The archive was stale at this check: it had no scores at all for week 9, week 10, and week 8 MNF - the verified feed fills those from official sources.
Every official game has a Game Center gamebook PDF (linked from its game page) with the full scoring summary - an authoritative per-game source.
rows.missing: Verified scores for 2023-2025 seasons and 2026 weeks 1-7 (931 rows archived-unverified).
discovery_suggestions: Build the gamebook-ingestion pipeline (suggestion S-02): one fetch per game extracts score, starters, inactives and weather from the official PDF.
Batch-verify week by week against nfl.com/scores/{season}/week-{n} pages (each covers a full week).
blocks: Officially verified backtests and ROI claims
Any 'verified' label on historical strategy performance

rows.question: Are our correlations computed from officially sourced numbers?
rows.information_needed: Correlation inputs whose provenance is official.
known_answers: No. All published correlations in the repo are computed on third-party archives (nflverse-derived datasets); each publishes n with the value and carries an archived-unverified label.
n is published with every value (e.g., results/correlations.json headline pair n = 6,021).
rows.missing: An officially sourced game-stats dataset wide enough to recompute correlations (the gamebooks are official but per-game; ingestion needed).
discovery_suggestions: Grow the verified results feed (S-02), then recompute the correlation table on the verified subset and publish both versions side by side.

rows.question: What is the depth string (2nd/3rd/4th) of a replacement player?
rows.information_needed: An official depth chart per team per week.
known_answers: No official depth chart is reachable: NFL.com team depth-chart URLs return 404 (FL-15, checked 2026-11-12). The official injury report carries Position/Injuries/Practice Status/Game Status only - no depth rank.

NEW: official gamebooks publish who actually STARTED each game (plus Did-Not-Play and Not-Active lists) - demonstrated on WAS@NYG 2026 wk10. This gives the fact of a replacement AND the identity of the replacement, officially.
rows.missing: An official string label (2nd/3rd/4th) for each player.
discovery_suggestions: Ingest gamebooks weekly (S-02) and track 'started in place of X' as an official fact.
If string labels are required, define them as OUR derived labels (e.g., starts in season to date per position) and publish them as derived, never as official.

rows.question: Is the leaderboard competition funded, and what do rewards cost?
rows.information_needed: A rewards budget decision from the owner.
known_answers: No. Rewards are virtual points only; the pool is unfunded and all strategy reward_points are currently 0 (no strategy has passed the gates). The NFL Big Data Bowl reference ($100,000 on Kaggle) is competition-design context, not our funding.
rows.missing: Owner decision: fund, virtualize explicitly, or remove.
discovery_suggestions: Decide among the three options in S-06 before promoting any strategy to live.
blocks: Promotion of any strategy to live

rows.question: Which strategies have passed validation and may compete for rewards?
known_answers: None. Every entrant in the ledger is tier NEEDS_REVIEW or REJECTED as of the latest build (insufficient sample, or failed integrity/statistical gates). The CTRL_LEAK control demonstrates why the gates exist (93.9% ROI via lookahead, rejected).
rows.missing: Larger verified samples and (for several families) the data gaps above.
discovery_suggestions: Grow the verified feed; re-run gates per strategy after each verified batch.

rows.question: What demotion thresholds should a live strategy face?
rows.information_needed: Owner decision on window length, p threshold, drawdown cap.
known_answers: A full specification is proposed (price-desk/data/demotion_gate.json): 100-bet window, permutation p > 0.10, 25% drawdown cap, process-violation and data-withdrawal triggers, one re-promotion per season.
rows.missing: Owner approval or revision of those parameters.
discovery_suggestions: Review S-07's parameter trade-off table and choose; the spec is parameterised so values can change without redesign.

rows.question: Can the model's published numbers be trusted given the open holdout-leakage issue?
rows.information_needed: Resolution of issue #9 (sigma fitted on holdout residuals in scripts/analyze_model.py).
known_answers: Issue #9 remains open with three specific defects (leakage in sigma fit, a misnamed 0.25 baseline key, missing tie term in away_fair). The disposition record is in COORDINATION.md (ISS-2 table); the fix has not landed.
rows.missing: The three localised edits plus a regression test (queued as S-05).
discovery_suggestions: Implement S-05 in the next root-pipeline session; until then treat calibration outputs as provisional.
blocks: Any claim that the model is market-grade

rows.question: How reliable is the third-party archive we compute on?
rows.information_needed: Cross-checks of archive values against official sources.
known_answers: Scores: 5 of 5 cross-checkable rows agreed digit-for-digit with official sources (2026 week 8, checked 2026-11-14); 17 more rows had no archive value and were filled from official sources; the archive was otherwise stale for weeks 9-10.
Prices: unverifiable (no official odds source, Q-01). The archive is the only price source and stays labelled archived-unverified.
discovery_suggestions: Keep cross-checking scores weekly via gamebooks (S-02); treat prices as unverified indefinitely until Q-01 resolves.

rows.question: Which decisions does this register block right now?
known_answers: Blocked: promoting any strategy to live (Q-05, Q-06), verified ROI claims (Q-02), opening-value strategies (Q-01), official correlation claims (Q-03), verified replacement-depth features (Q-04), trusting calibration (Q-08).
Not blocked: continuing research, paper competition, growing the verified feed, choosing S-01..S-10 paths.
rows.missing: Nothing - this row is the triage summary.
discovery_suggestions: Work the suggestions queue top-down; S-02 (gamebook ingestion) unblocks the most items per unit of effort.
